what: release core-v0.7 from the reviewed branches (merge on Fable, then the release clerk); fresh verifier for G2 of Track E; claims package of the knowledge base
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.6 are on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0030 to 0035. The usage window of this account is small (decision 0032 item 1): read what the task needs.

items.task: MERGE of core's finished source branches into core/nrpic as release candidate core-v0.7 (coord/DECISIONS/0035 item 4). If tracks/core/RELEASE-v0.7.md already exists on core/nrpic with a regression result, verify it in a minute and return 'already complete'. core/nrpic holds release core-v0.6 and later records (tracks/core/RELEASE-v0.6.md; drivers tracks/core/analysis/release/). Branches: (1) core/noise-level2 (worktree wt/core-s2): level 2 of the stochastic backreaction and the mode equation of the noise on the mesh for the scalar field (<scalar_field> noise_level = 2, noise_mode_eq, and the other options of tracks/core/interfaces/noise_level2.md), written on Opus and REVIEWED on Fable on 2026-11-24 with the verdict 'results unchanged' (its journal; tracks/core/verify/noise_level2_close on that branch); its card run R5 of the reviewed build is shared-queue entry q0035. (2) core/step-limit (worktree wt/core-s3): <z4c> dt_gauge with the start-up warning; restart outputs written on the termination signal (no option: a change that acts for every run); scripts/submit_chain.sh (an attempt cut by a signal is not counted; nothing queued after the last segment; MAX_TERM_IN_A_ROW); its card smoke run is queue entry q0036; its outbox message to orch lists the lines touched in shared files. (3) core/gauge-2: <z4c> lapse_leak_hole, which enters as a MITIGATION of the relaxed lapse's defect and is named so in the changelog and in OPEN.md (coord/DECISIONS/0025 item 3); it has not merged main since release v0.6. (4) core/clump-table (boosted equilibrium clumps): take it only if its branch is closed (READY published 2026-11-21; its card run M2: decide from its journal and READY whether what is tested suffices; otherwise leave it out with the reason). core/oblate is not ready: leave it. Steps as for the earlier releases: read each diff against main as the maintainer; one merge commit per branch; resolve conflicts in shared files (CMakeLists.txt, z4c.hpp, driver.cpp, docs/FORMATS.md) by hand and read the result; build the processor, threaded and MPI executables and the card executable (the card build needs no card); byte regression on processors against the release processor executable of core-v0.6 (/data/haiyangw/nrpic/.work/build_cpu_v06/src/athena) on the regression set-ups with every new option absent: say exactly which files differ because of the changes that act without an option (the stop on the termination signal should change none); the quick test of each merged branch from its READY; the card check of the merged card executable is handed to the shared queue (harness/bin/nrpic-queue add, priority 2, at most one card-hour, one entry) and NOT waited for: the cards have been held by another partition for two days; say in RELEASE-v0.7.md which card checks are pending and the command that judges them. tracks/core/stage/G2/OPEN.md: the two restart defects the step-limit session found, the mitigation status of lapse_leak_hole, what level 2 does not support (refinement, several ranks, a lapse that varies in space). Publish /data/haiyangw/nrpic/scratch/core/exe/core_nrpic_v07/ (athena_gpu, athena_cpu, athena_cpu_omp, athena_cpu_mpi, COMMIT, SHA256SUMS, READY with an example input per new option). tracks/core/CHANGELOG.md section core-v0.7 (options, changes that act without an option, scripts); tracks/core/RELEASE-v0.7.md with the first line exactly 'RELEASE core-v0.7 <full source commit, taken from git rev-parse> REGRESSION PASS' or '... REGRESSION FAIL'; commit and push core/nrpic.

items.title: fresh verifier for gate G2 (criteria of scope section 4c)
items.task: Fresh verifier for gate G2 of this track (decision 0016 item 4; coord/DECISIONS/0035 item 1). Trust nothing and do not read the lead's verdicts first (g2prod/JOURNAL.md entries 2 to 4, stage/REVIEW-wave3.md, stage/G2/CHECKLIST.md): take the criteria from spec/scope/SCOPE.md section 4c exactly as fixed before the runs (U-A0 to U-A4' (a) to (d), U-R, U-S, U-W, the floor and the clause on the maxima) and the list of runs from g2prod's README and queue files (the ultra-slow-roll ladder on the release card build of core-v0.6: mirrored pairs at 256 cells, seeds A and B, the 320-cell pair, the half-amplitude pair, the control with the flipped sign, and the quarter-amplitude pair). With your own readers and reference (a reader of package repro/verify may be used after a test on an analytic field), on processors only (at most 6 cores; one 256-cell dump in memory at a time; look at uptime first), predictions first: recompute for each criterion the number it is judged by, and say per criterion CONFIRMED, NOT CONFIRMED or WRONG with the evidence; then the failure on record (the even-part halving of the momentum constraint at one dump): recompute it and say what the quarter-amplitude pair shows about it. tracks/E-stoch-inf/stage/G2/VERIFIER.md: what was checked and how, the table per criterion, what could not be checked, the three weakest points of the package. Registered runs; figures looked at. Commit path-limited.

items.title: claims: two seeds of the brief, supersede action, the weak class, fragments
items.task: Claims package of the knowledge base, third (tracks/kb/HANDOFF.md and stage/KB-G3/OPEN.md say why; coord/DECISIONS/0035 item 5). (1) The brief's seeds 803 (stability of matter-dominated FLRW) and 805 (three derivations to check): read each against the sources in the store and the tracks' own checks (coord/notes/derivations_to_check.md with its 'Checked' sections; the tracks' scope files through git show), and verify, refute or annotate with locators. (2) A 'supersede' action of the claims tool: a claim whose wording is wrong is closed with a pointer to the claim that replaces it, with history (claim 682 to 862 is the first case); tests. (3) The class of claims the KB-G3 verifier found weak: marked processed by a pipeline step without being read against their own wording. Find that class by query, re-read a random sample of thirty at their locators (seed committed before the draw), correct what is wrong, and give the rate with its interval. (4) The fragment claims (85, 620, 549 and those listed in claims_tracks/AUDIT.md): re-seed or close each. (5) arXiv:0707.4654 and arXiv:1006.1632 leave the downloads table (their files stay). Predictions first; registered runs; LEDGER and figures as the earlier claims packages; no snapshot (the lead takes it). README.md; JOURNAL.md.
